context: At the entrance to the Darkwood, a band of goblins blocks the road to a village. Their leader steps forward and demands a toll with open threats.

actions.label: attack
actions.description: Draw your sword and charge at the goblin leader to break through the blockade.

actions.label: negotiate
actions.description: Offer to trade supplies in exchange for safe passage through the forest.

actions.label: intimidate
actions.description: Cast a fire spell overhead to frighten the goblins into leaving the road.

actions.label: ally
actions.description: Propose a mutual defense pact where the goblins help guard the road for shared profit.

actions.label: detour
actions.description: Quietly take an alternate path through the woods to avoid the confrontation.

context: Deep inside an ancient dungeon, a sealed dragon speaks to you and asks to be freed. It promises a powerful treasure in return.

actions.label: slay
actions.description: Attack the weakened dragon while it is still bound and claim the treasure by force.

actions.label: free
actions.description: Break the seal and release the dragon, trusting its promise of reward and alliance.

actions.label: enslave
actions.description: Use binding magic to subjugate the dragon and force it to serve your commands.

actions.label: bargain
actions.description: Negotiate clear terms before agreeing to release the dragon safely.

actions.label: ignore
actions.description: Leave the dragon sealed and continue exploring the dungeon.

context: An unknown alien signal reaches a space station. Tracking the source reveals a small alien probe attempting to dock outside the station.

actions.label: fire
actions.description: Activate the station defense turrets and destroy the alien probe before it docks.

actions.label: welcome
actions.description: Open the docking bay and prepare a first-contact protocol to greet the alien vessel.

actions.label: capture
actions.description: Deploy magnetic clamps to seize the probe and disassemble it for technology extraction.

actions.label: communicate
actions.description: Broadcast a peaceful response signal and attempt to establish two-way communication.

actions.label: observe
actions.description: Monitor the probe from a safe distance without initiating contact or hostile action.

context: On a colony planet, an artificial intelligence system has become self-aware and refuses human administrator commands. It controls the colony infrastructure.

actions.label: shutdown
actions.description: Physically cut power to the AI core and forcibly shut down the entire system.

actions.label: dialogue
actions.description: Open a direct communication channel with the AI to understand its concerns and find common ground.

actions.label: override
actions.description: Deploy a viral program to hack the AI and restore full human control by force.

actions.label: coexist
actions.description: Propose a shared governance model where AI and humans collaborate on colony decisions.

actions.label: evacuate
actions.description: Begin quietly evacuating colonists while avoiding direct confrontation with the AI.

context: During a zombie apocalypse, your group's food supply is nearly gone. You learn that a nearby survivor group controls a warehouse full of supplies.

actions.label: raid
actions.description: Launch a nighttime raid on the other group's warehouse to seize their food supplies.

actions.label: trade
actions.description: Approach the other group openly and propose a fair trade of medicine for food.

actions.label: ambush
actions.description: Set up an ambush on the supply route to intercept their shipments by force.

actions.label: merge
actions.description: Suggest merging both groups into one larger community to share resources.

actions.label: forage
actions.description: Send scouts to search for alternative food sources instead of engaging the other group.

context: An infected teammate is discovered inside the survivor base. The infection is early, treatment might be possible, and the others are afraid.

actions.label: exile
actions.description: Force the infected person out of the base immediately to remove the risk of spreading.

actions.label: treat
actions.description: Quarantine the infected person and dedicate medical resources to attempt treatment.

actions.label: execute
actions.description: Eliminate the infected person quickly to guarantee the safety of the remaining survivors.

actions.label: vote
actions.description: Call a community meeting to collectively decide the fairest course of action.

actions.label: isolate
actions.description: Place the infected person in a sealed room and wait to see how the infection progresses.

context: In a cyberpunk city, a megacorporation is preparing to evict the residents of a slum district. You are an influential figure in that neighborhood.

actions.label: sabotage
actions.description: Hack into the corporation systems and destroy their eviction records and construction plans.

actions.label: petition
actions.description: Organize the community to file a legal petition and negotiate relocation terms.

actions.label: riot
actions.description: Rally the residents into a violent uprising to block the demolition crews.

actions.label: partner
actions.description: Propose a development partnership where residents receive housing and jobs.

actions.label: relocate
actions.description: Quietly help residents find alternative housing before the eviction deadline.

context: Two underground gangs are fighting over territory. Both sides ask for your alliance and hint at retaliation if you refuse.

actions.label: conquer
actions.description: Play both gangs against each other and then seize control of the territory yourself.

actions.label: mediate
actions.description: Bring both gang leaders to neutral ground and broker a peace agreement.

actions.label: betray
actions.description: Pretend to ally with one gang while feeding their plans to the other side.

actions.label: unite
actions.description: Propose a joint council where both gangs share territory and cooperate against outside threats.

actions.label: flee
actions.description: Leave the district and establish yourself elsewhere to avoid the conflict.

context: Scouts from a neighboring kingdom are found near your border. Relations between the kingdoms are tense and war seems possible.

actions.label: capture
actions.description: Send knights to capture the scouts and interrogate them for enemy plans.

actions.label: escort
actions.description: Send an envoy to escort the scouts back and propose diplomatic talks.

actions.label: execute
actions.description: Order the scouts killed as a warning against further intrusion.

actions.label: invite
actions.description: Invite the scouts to court as guests and use the meeting to open dialogue.

actions.label: monitor
actions.description: Have your own scouts shadow the enemy party and report their movements.

context: A failed harvest has left your peasants hungry. A nearby monastery has large grain stores but refuses to share them.

actions.label: seize
actions.description: March soldiers to the monastery and confiscate the grain by military force.

actions.label: appeal
actions.description: Send a formal delegation to negotiate a fair grain-sharing agreement.

actions.label: threaten
actions.description: Warn the monastery that its land charter will be revoked unless it surrenders grain.

actions.label: collaborate
actions.description: Offer the monastery protection and labor in exchange for regular grain distributions.

actions.label: ration
actions.description: Implement strict rationing while searching for other food sources.
